steps.say: Speak clearly and not too fast, so everyone can follow.
Look at your listeners and stand tall.
When you read aloud, pause at full stops. Change your voice for questions and shouts.
steps.show: Where is it? Here it is!

steps.say: In a group, take turns and listen to others.
When you give an opinion, use because to give reasons.
steps.show: I like sunny days because I can play outside.

check.prompt: How should you read a question aloud?
hints: Say a question out loud and listen.
What happens to your voice at the end?
check.explanation: When we ask a question, our voice goes up at the end.

options.text: Let your voice go up at the end.
